title: Interactive map shows where Angelenos voted for Nithya Raman over Karen Bass in L.A. mayoral race
text:
Where Mayor-elect Nithya Raman defeated incumbent Karen Bass: Interactive map of the Los Angeles mayoral vote - ABC7 Los Angeles 
 24/7 Live Los Angeles Orange County Inland Empire Ventura County California Midterm Elections 
 Interactive map shows where Angelenos voted for Nithya Raman over Karen Bass in L.A. mayoral race 
 Raman's strongest support came from East L.A., parts of the San Fernando Valley. 
 An ABC7 analysis of precinct-level election results shows a sharp geographic divide in the Los Angeles mayoral race between Mayor-elect Nithya Raman and current Mayor Karen Bass. SOURCE: LOS ANGELES COUNTY REGISTRAR-RECORDER/ COUNTY CLERK By Kevin Ozebek Saturday, November 7, 2026 12:41AM Share LOS ANGELES (KABC) -- An ABC7 analysis of precinct-level election results shows a sharp geographic divide in the Los Angeles mayoral race, with Mayor-elect Nithya Raman's strongest support concentrated in East Los Angeles and parts of the San Fernando Valley.
 The interactive map, based on precinct-level results representing 67% of the expected vote, illustrates an east-west voting divide across Los Angeles.
 Precincts shaded yellow indicate stronger support for Raman, while purple precincts indicate stronger support for Karen Bass.
 Click here to find out which precinct you vote in . 
 According to the map, Raman secured the mayor's office largely because of her strong performance in East Los Angeles and a solid showing in the heart of the San Fernando Valley.
 One notable finding was Raman's performance within her own City Council district, Council District 4, which stretches from Griffith Park through Los Feliz and west to Encino.

 While Raman performed strongly in Los Feliz, Bass carried some Valley precincts decisively. In one Studio City precinct, Bass received nearly 70% of the vote. In an Encino precinct, Bass also garnered nearly 70% support.
 The Palisades, where Bass has faced criticism related to her absence from the country during the 2025 Los Angeles fires, also delivered a strong result for the outgoing mayor. Despite nearly two years of tension with Bass in the neighborhood, she received more than 70% of the vote there.
 In Boyle Heights, a community that has also expressed frustration with City Hall over the Lineage fire, Raman posted strong results. In one precinct, she won more than two-thirds of the vote.
 Voters can explore precinct-level results in their own neighborhoods through the interactive map above.
